up: Retrieve activity data for assay CHEMBL5732041. Return the canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for each compound tested. Filter results to include only rows where the standard value is non-null and the standard relation is exactly '='. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5732041'
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
